full_prompt_en: A square, finely finished oil painting centers on a young woman in a vivid red dress patterned with pale flowers. She sits close to the picture plane, her head tilted slightly and one cheek resting in the palm of her hand. Her dark brown hair is parted neatly and pulled back, leaving a smooth pale forehead and softly flushed cheeks. Blue gray eyes meet the viewer with a quiet, distant expression, while the small rose-colored mouth remains relaxed. The red garment fills almost all of the lower half, its ample sleeves folding around the bent arms. Cream floral motifs and delicate gold lines run across the fabric, changing scale as the cloth turns around the shoulders and lap. Behind her, deep green foliage and large red orange flowers make a richly colored wall. Thin stems and petal shapes remain visible within the dark growth, but the background stays subordinate to the face. At the left edge, a sliver of another dark-clothed figure with a pale face and bright earring is cropped by the frame. At the right, part of a white sleeve and yellow-gold garment belonging to another figure enters, making the central woman feel seated among companions without shifting the focus. The near skin is blended smoothly, while textile and foliage carry finer repeated marks and glints. Warm light arrives from the upper left and front, brightening the forehead, nose, hand and cream pattern. Deep green and red brown shadows around the edges strengthen the luminous pale face. No strong cast shadow crosses the features; contrast comes from the quiet central light against the dense ornament. The overall composition places an introspective face within a tapestry of red flowers and textured cloth, balancing human stillness with decorative abundance.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、完成细腻的油画把一位穿鲜红色浅花纹连衣裙的年轻女子放在中央。她靠近画面坐着，头略倾，一侧脸颊托在手心。深褐发整齐中分并向后收，露出平滑浅额头和微微红润的双颊。蓝灰色眼睛以安静而遥远的神情望向观者，小小玫瑰色嘴唇自然放松。红衣占满下半幅几乎全部，宽大袖子绕着弯曲手臂起褶。奶油色花朵纹样与细金线横过衣料，随布料绕过肩膀和腿部改变尺度。身后深绿枝叶与大朵红橙花构成浓艳墙面。细枝与花瓣形在暗绿色中仍可见，但背景服从面部。左边缘，一小片另一位深衣人物的浅色面孔与亮耳环被画面截断。右侧，另一位人物的白袖与金黄色衣物进入画面，让中央女子显得坐在同伴之间，却不转移焦点。近处皮肤平滑融合，织物和植物则带更细密的重复笔痕与亮点。暖光从左上和正前方照来，提亮额头、鼻梁、手和奶油色花纹。边缘的深绿与红褐阴影加强发光般的浅面孔。没有强投影横过五官；反差来自安静中央亮部与浓密纹饰的对置。整体构图把沉思面孔置于红花与带肌理衣料织成的图案中，以人的静止平衡装饰的丰盛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely finished oil-painted surface that contrasts smooth pale modeling with dense decorative marks. Vivid red and cream patterning forms a broad lower mass, while deep green and red orange areas fill the surrounding space. Repeated floral curves and delicate gold lines enrich the surface without obscuring the central light-dark hierarchy. Soft warm light from an upper frontal side lifts one pale zone, and darker saturated edges enclose it. Edges are gentle on smooth focal planes but crisp within patterned cloth and layered foliage. The space is shallow and tapestry-like, built through overlap and changes in detail density. Small bright accents occur throughout, yet their size and repetition keep them secondary to the large color shapes. The overall effect is lush and contemplative, with ornamental rhythm supporting a quiet illuminated center.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有细腻完成的油画表面，平滑浅色塑形对照密集装饰笔痕。鲜红与奶油色纹样形成宽阔下方团块，深绿与红橙色区域填满周围。重复花形曲线和细金线丰富表面，却不遮住中央明暗层级。上方偏正面的柔暖光提亮一块浅色区域，较深且饱和的边缘将其围住。平滑焦点平面边缘温和，花纹衣料和层叠植物内部则清晰。空间浅而像挂毯，由交叠和细节密度变化搭成。细小亮点遍布各处，但尺寸及重复规律使其服从大色形。整体效果浓艳而沉思，装饰节奏托住安静受光中心。
theme_en: A young woman in a red floral dress resting her cheek on her hand
theme_zh: 一位穿红色花纹裙的年轻女子用手托着脸颊
name: Frank Cadogan Cowper
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
